text: The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 14 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank Danamon, number 4959368273, in the name of Golden Systems Ltd.
Late payment accrues interest of 1.5% per month on the overdue amount.
The Supplier delivers within 5 calendar days of receiving a purchase order.
Partial deliveries are allowed; the remainder is delivered and invoiced once received.
